events.text: {npc} has outpaced every other disciple in the sect. The others have started to whisper that {he} is your favourite.

mem.note: praised me before everyone

effects.log: {npc} glows. The other disciples go very quiet. You have made a star, and perhaps a problem.

choices.text: Praise {him} in private, and push {him} harder

mem.note: pushed me harder than anyone

effects.log: {npc} trains until {his} hands bleed, and never once boasts.

events.text: {npc} has heard you spent an evening teaching another disciple. {He} confronts you in the courtyard: 'Why them? I am better.'

choices.text: Tell {him} the truth: being better is not enough

mem.note: told me a hard truth

effects.log: {npc} storms off. Three days later {he} comes back and asks what else there is to learn. It is a beginning.

choices.text: Put {him} in charge of the outer disciples

mem.note: trusted me with the outer disciples

effects.log: Responsibility does what praise could not. {npc} becomes a fierce, fair teacher.

mem.note: shamed me before the whole sect

effects.log: {npc} bows, white-faced. That night {he} leaves the sect without a word, and takes a manual with {him}.

events.text: Years later, {npc}, the genius who left your sect, stands at your gate. {He} is strong now, and wants you to see it.

mem.note: beat me, and then helped me up

ok.log: You win, and help {him} up. {npc} weeps. Then {he} asks to come home. You say yes.

mem.note: fought me honestly

fail.log: {npc} wins. {He} does not gloat. {He} bows, the way you taught {him}, and leaves.

mem.note: forgave me without a word

effects.log: Tea, then silence, then everything {he} never said. {npc} stays the night, and then stays.

events.text: You notice {npc} for the first time in years: always the last to bed, the first awake, the one the younger disciples go to when they cry.

mem.note: saw me when no one else did

effects.log: {npc} is terrified, then careful, then very good at it. (You may have found your successor.)
Some people are happiest unseen. {npc} goes on quietly holding your sect together.

events.text: The elders doubt your chosen successor. They want {npc} tested in front of the whole sect.

mem.note: believed in me before the elders

ok.log: {npc} answers every question, and the last one with a question of {his} own. The elders stop doubting.

mem.note: stood by me when I failed

fail.log: {npc} stumbles. You stand beside {him} and say {he} will be ready in time. {He} will.

mem.note: defended me before the elders

effects.log: The elders back down. They will remember, and so will {npc}.

events.text: {npc} has run the sect for a season while you were in seclusion. Nothing burned down. Several things improved.

mem.note: told me I was ready

effects.log: {npc} says nothing for a long moment, then bows lower than you have ever seen anyone bow.
{npc} has a list. It is a good list. The sect changes, and is better for it.

events.text: Small things: {npc} is out at night, has new silver, and cannot meet your eyes. An elder thinks {he} is selling the sect's art.

effects.log: You say nothing and watch. It is the hardest thing you have done as head of the sect.

mem.note: asked me straight instead of spying on me

effects.log: {npc} breaks down: a sick mother, a debt, a rival sect that pays well. {He} begs forgiveness, and you pay the debt before the week is out.

events.text: You follow {npc} at night to a rival sect's agent, a sealed copy of your sect's art in {his} hands.

effects.log: {npc} drops the manual and kneels in the mud. The agent runs. You have to decide what kind of leader you are.

choices.text: Let it happen, and feed them a false manual

effects.log: The rival sect trains a false art for a year. {npc} never knows you saw.

events.text: {npc} kneels before the whole sect, waiting for your judgement for selling its art.

mem.note: expelled me before the whole sect

effects.log: {npc} walks out of the gate with nothing. The sect is quiet for a month. Discipline holds.

mem.note: forgave me and paid my debt

effects.log: The sect is shocked. {npc} becomes the most loyal disciple you will ever have.

events.text: {npc} has broken through to a new realm. The whole sect wants a feast, and {npc} wants you to say something.

mem.note: spoke at my breakthrough feast

effects.log: Three sentences. {npc} remembers every word for the rest of {his} life.

mem.note: gave me their own old sword

effects.log: The whole hall goes silent. {npc} holds it like it might break.

events.text: Two of your disciples, {npc} and another, are in love, and terrified you will forbid it.

mem.note: blessed us

effects.log: The whole sect cheers. A wedding in the main hall, the first of many.

choices.text: Tell them to wait until their training is done

mem.note: made us wait

effects.log: They wait. They are very, very patient about it, and very obvious.

events.text: {npc} asks permission to leave for three years and wander the murim alone, as many a young fighter has.

mem.note: let me wander

effects.log: {npc} leaves at dawn. Letters arrive from every corner of the empire. {He} comes back changed, and better.

choices.text: Ask {him} to stay one more year

mem.note: asked me to stay a year

effects.log: {npc} stays, a little sadly. The year is a good one anyway.

events.text: On the road, an assassin's knife comes for your back. {npc} steps into it first.

mem.note: carried me home after I took a knife for them

effects.log: {npc} lives, barely. When {he} wakes, {his} first question is whether you are hurt.

choices.text: Leave {him} with a physician and hunt the assassin

mem.note: avenged the knife I took for them

effects.log: You find the assassin by morning. When {npc} wakes, the danger is over and you are sitting by the bed.
